capability: Only trusted input acts; page scripts cannot inject marks or pen presence; frame card/ask completion accepted only for the frame that completed the current authorized top ASK
environment: Desktop only: Microsoft Edge 154.0.4258.37 (Chromium) headless on Windows 10.0.26200 via WSL2 interop; synthetic DOM events (self-test) and CDP Input events (trusted check). Not Safari, not iPad, no Apple Pencil.
limitation: Round 1 overstated this: only self-posted top-page messages were tested, and a child frame could relay a fixture card in NAV/WRITE/after a cancelled ASK (peer review F2, fixed in round 2). Now a card is shown only after that frame completed the current authorized top ASK, once. Coordination is still window.postMessage: a script in a peer-origin child frame can complete a live ASK and show an exact-fixture card for it. The packaged extension must carry mode and results through extension messaging (background with frameId), which pages cannot forge.
fallback: Extension messaging in the packaged extension.
